subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: Should OpenClaw support UUID-like Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan keys on the general `volcengine/*` DeepSeek route, steer those users to `volcengine-plan/*`, or treat that key type as unsupported with clearer diagnostics?
rationale: The code can be changed in several plausible places, but the safe behavior depends on the vendor entitlement contract and whether maintainers want routing support or only a diagnostic for this key class.

options.title: Live-confirm and repair provider-owned behavior
options.body: Use a real Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan key to confirm which endpoint/model refs accept it, then update the Volcengine plugin docs, diagnostics, and tests accordingly.

options.title: Document unsupported key type
options.body: If the UUID-like Lite key is not intended for OpenClaw's ModelArk routes, keep runtime routing unchanged and add a clearer setup/runtime diagnostic for that failure.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Leave this issue open until the reporter or a credentialed tester provides redacted logs proving the exact key type, endpoint, and model combination.

recommendation.title: Live-confirm and repair provider-owned behavior
recommendation.body: Use a real Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan key to confirm which endpoint/model refs accept it, then update the Volcengine plugin docs, diagnostics, and tests accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth alias behavior and plugin-owned catalog/setup boundaries where this history is strongest.
